versions.changelog:
- Initial release of docs-improver: a professional tool for analyzing, generating, and improving technical documentation.
- Provides automated quality assessment (integrity, clarity, structure, maintainability, accuracy).
- Automatically generates missing documents such as README, API docs, and more.
- Checks consistency between documentation and code (APIs, examples, architecture, configs).
- Offers actionable improvement suggestions with prioritization.
- Comes with professional templates and diagram examples; supports all programming languages.
